method: Analytical source review, not executable mathematics

gates.name: Simultaneous code bounds and literal projection rank
gates.reason: For random k byL matrix, each nonzero message image is uniform and each nonzero dual test has uniform k-bit syndrome. The two union bounds include rank failure in the primal event and weights1..floor(alpha L) in the dual event. The entropy ball estimate follows from z=p/(1-p)<1 including noninteger endpoints. CODE-GATE<1 yields both properties and full rankk. A dual word supported inS is exactly a nontrivial column relation, so every allowed coordinate projection is onto; uniform codewords project uniformly. k=ceil(RL)<L eventually and both strict exponential bounds decay with the stated entropy inequalities.

gates.name: Strictly positive mixture and exact labelled marginals
gates.reason: eta>0 gives mu(x)>0 on every configuration; this is not a hard-support limit. Uniform code and full product both have the same labelled marginals throughr, so their mixture does exactly too. At code points the common weighta=(1-eta)/m+eta/2^L is correct. Arbitrarily small probabilities remain permitted, and no uniform positivity constant is claimed.

gates.name: Transfer positivity and normalization
gates.reason: q=e^-2beta lies in(0,1). The tensor factors have eigenvalues1+q,1-q>0, so M and every positive diagonal congruence are positive definite. Entrywise positivity supplies a simple positive Perron root. Uniform weight scales M by2^-L; all nontrivial top ratios are(1-q)/(1+q)=tanh beta. The unnormalized Ising kernel differs by e^(beta L), which leaves ratios unchanged. No heat-bath operator is substituted.

gates.name: Finite many-eigenvalue bound
gates.reason: The m bym code principal block equals aM_CC. Absolute row-sum bound s=(m-1)e^-2beta d_C puts all its eigenvalues in a[1-s,1+s]. Interlacing gives full lambda_m>=a(1-s), even if vacuous. The outside block isPSD with trace<=eta, and cross Frobenius norm squared<=mass_C mass_out<=eta. Thus top eigenvalue<=a(1+s)+sqrt eta+eta, while>=a by coordinate Rayleigh vector. Subtraction and division bylambda1>=a, a>=1/(2m), give2s+2m(sqrt eta+eta) for everyj2..m. All eigenvalues positive and Perron simple make the gap strictlypositive for each finite positive weight.

gates.name: Fixed-beta constants, floors and exponential multiplicity
gates.reason: delta1/4, R=min((1-h(delta))/2,beta/(4ln2)) ispositive andbelow1-h(delta); alpha withh(alpha)<R exists. gamma=beta/2-Rln2>=beta/4. Ceiling givesm<=2e^(Rln2 L); hence2s<=4e^-gammaL. eta=e^-2betaL/m² is<=1/4 and thetwo outside terms are<=3e^-betaL<=3e^-gammaL. There are exactlym-1 non-Perron indices bounded, with multiplicities counted, andm<2^L eventually. No equality of their eigenvalues or numerical extrapolation is needed.

gates.name: Actual Perron-Doob stationary law
gates.reason: P_xy=A_xy v_y/(lambda1 v_x) is strictlypositive and stochastic by the Perron equation. pi=v² is normalized and detailed balance holds by symmetry; P is similar to A/lambda1, so ratios are its actual positive nontrivial eigenvalues. Addition by every codeword preserves bothmu andM, henceA. Normalized positive Perron uniqueness makesv andpi code-translation invariant. Surjective code projection gives every translation on each allowed coordinate set, forcing pi marginal uniform. This proves the extra stationary-law claim without assertingpi=mu.

gates.name: Literal certificate scope
gates.reason: The certificate input is exactly L,beta and the labelled low-order marginal tuples ofmu and/orpi. Constructed input equals product input at eachlargeL, so any valid lower bound on the full positive-weight class is<=the actual constructed gap<=7e^-gammaL. This prevents a positive L-uniform product-input certificate, not the actual product-chain gap. Fixed-range Gibbs/local generators, full conditionals, weight lower bounds and operator/code data are not in this input/class. No physical/entropy/mixing-time theorem is inferred.

gates.name: Predecessors, novelty and negative controls
gates.reason: Parity215 proves a different conditional heat-bath spectrum and marginal-information obstruction; its positive law/marginal tuple mechanism is reused, not rediscovered. Congruence scientific Sections1-8 prove fusion/least-pair ratios and uniform concentrations, not linear-order marginal preservation or the constructed stationary-law tuple and exponentially many slow modes. The antipodal pair already has nonproduct pair marginals, and the exchangeable-cluster formula is not a formula for arbitrary unequal code correlations.294 is therefore more than a notation replacement within these own texts, but is an elementary synthesis of classical code, matrix and symmetry tools. Broad external originality remains unestablished. Section6 is separately checked in full below.
